description: Defines the AgentWorkspace enum which manages workspace files, directory structure, templates, and bootstrap logic for OpenClaw project.

classes.name: AgentWorkspace.BootstrapSafety
classes.description: Represents the safety status of a workspace, indicating if it's safe to bootstrap.

methods.name: displayPath
methods.description: Converts a URL to a display-friendly path, replacing the home directory with ~.

methods.name: resolveWorkspaceURL
methods.description: Resolves a workspace URL from user input, expanding tildes and defaulting if input is empty.

methods.name: agentsURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for the agents file within the given workspace.

methods.name: workspaceEntries
methods.description: Lists non-ignored entries in the workspace directory.

methods.name: isWorkspaceEmpty
methods.description: Checks whether the workspace directory exists and is empty.

methods.name: isTemplateOnlyWorkspace
methods.description: Determines if the workspace contains only template files.

methods.name: bootstrapSafety
methods.description: Evaluates if the workspace is safe to bootstrap based on its contents.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Initializes the workspace, creating necessary files and directories if needed.

methods.name: needsBootstrap
methods.description: Checks if the workspace requires bootstrap.

methods.name: hasIdentity
methods.description: Checks if the IDENTITY.md file contains any non-empty identity data.

methods.name: defaultTemplate
methods.description: Provides default content for the AGENTS.md workspace template.

methods.name: defaultSoulTemplate
methods.description: Provides default content for the SOUL.md template.

methods.name: defaultIdentityTemplate
methods.description: Provides default content for the IDENTITY.md template.

methods.name: defaultUserTemplate
methods.description: Provides default content for the USER.md template.

methods.name: defaultBootstrapTemplate
methods.description: Provides default content for the BOOTSTRAP.md template.
